newsitem.title: USA: Triton to merge with Security Systems.
newsitem.headline: Triton to merge with Security Systems.

text.p: Triton Group Ltd on Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to merge with Security Systems Holdings Inc, the Orange, Connecticut-based parent of Alarmguard Inc.

The company said the agreement called for the issuance of common stock to Security stockholders. Afterwards, the combined entity would be 43 percent owned by Triton shareholders and 57 percent owned by Security Systems shareholders.
In a statement, it provided no specific financial terms of the transaction.
The deal is expected to close before March 31.
